scientific_question: Can the original learned radius-composition information support useful dynamic feature adaptation when consumed through a fixed ordinal cumulative score rather than only the fine-class probability?

candidate_selection_disclosure.evidence: The existing 96-patch TRAIN bank suggested a stronger retrospective ordinal readout than raw fine; this is candidate-selection evidence, not independent confirmation.

scope.only_scientific_candidate_change: Fixed scalar condition consumption map; the static reference maps the same uniform five-class vector through that map.

score.meaning: Average cumulative nonempty scale mass at the three original operational radius edges; an ordinal fineness score, not radius in mm or a clinical category.
score.conditional_composition_diagnostic: r_k=p_k/sum(p1..p4), k=1..4; ordinal(r)=r1+(2/3)*r2+(1/3)*r3; zero nonempty mass is unsupported, not silently assigned a uniform conditional composition.

model.base_G0: Original constant operator; q0=s0=.2 and uniform structure condition remain unchanged.
model.static_reference_identifiability: With constant .4, b+.4*w is a redundant static intercept just as b+.2*w was previously; parameter count alone does not equalize variable function capacity.

training.optimizer: Original AdamW; fresh state per arm

case_partitions.fit_probe_source_balance: Eight fit and four probe cases from each source.
case_partitions.case_partition_origin: Original frozen local-readout plan 8aacf68f45e706e9b1236a1d76c505c638851ae0fd508ae721d004ff02abeaac; only case IDs reused, not the old patch bank.

bank.sampling: Exact eight draws per stratum and case using the original patch128 center/jitter/clipping conventions; match the .5 mixture by stratification, not the realized random training sequence.
bank.padding_policy: Original sampler padding and real-CT validity retained; no new no-padding subset.
bank.old_bank_coordinate_collisions: Record exact collisions; do not resample. New sampling is prospective, not a claim of unseen images.
bank.model_for_prerequisite: Frozen original7406 classifier, evaluation mode, no parameter/BN/RNG update.
bank.RNG_algorithm: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence([2026102301,case_index,slot])); case_index follows original TRAIN manifest order

semantics.primary_population: Valid known-nonempty FG-jitter primary slots of the twelve probe cases; equal mean over case means.
semantics.GT_score: Apply the fixed ordinal coefficients to the ORIGINAL native-derived geometry class composition at the original points.
semantics.raw_prediction: Recorded FP32 c_ord actually destined for the feature operation.
semantics.fit_constant: Equal mean of each fit case's mean valid-known-nonempty FG-jitter GT score, using fit24 only. No regression, head fitting, intercept calibration or probe-label fitting.
semantics.conditional_fit_constant: Same construction using the nonempty conditional ordinal target; report separately.

within_case_correlations.pooled_definition: Subtract each case's valid-primary GT and prediction means, concatenate valid primary rows, then Pearson-correlate; also report the equal mean of defined case correlations.
within_case_correlations.undefined_values: Null with reason; do not fill zero or drop from the required12-case denominator.
within_case_correlations.positive_case_count_scope: Count only cases meeting the declared GT-variance, predicted-score-SD and known-nonempty-primary support criteria; still require>=8 of the original12.

measurement.meaning: Cross-grid consistency of the existing surrogate definition, not expert annotation error or clinical validity.
measurement.input: All original stored native-derived radii at the existing55,294 TRAIN skeleton anchors, and cached1mm mask physical EDT sampled at those EXACT anchors.
measurement.EDT: Compute from each FULL cached case mask with physical spacing; never compute a patch-truncated EDT.
measurement.invalid_or_disappearing_support: Report individually and fail input-integrity checks; never replace missing support by radius0 or silently remove it.
measurement.primary_population: The same valid nonempty FG-jitter patches of probe12 used by semantic gates.
measurement.noise_MSE: Mean over probe cases of the within-case mean squared difference between original-native-derived and cached-mask-EDT ordinal patch targets.
measurement.signal_variance: Mean over probe cases of population variance of original-native-derived ordinal FG-jitter patch targets.
measurement.interpretation: An opportunity-cost signal-to-cross-grid-discrepancy requirement: discrepancy RMSE at most half the within-case target SD in the aggregate. Not a confidence bound.

execution_and_readout_order.if_A_or_B_fails: Do not select another seed or extend any budget. Keep C numeric result sealed from decision-making; audit and report all three block outcomes under an explicitly recorded terminal failure/unsealing procedure, never choose a positive C as a replacement winner.

utility_gate.unit: Percentage points on all original8 VAL case metrics, case-equal means
utility_gate.sample_SD: Report only; cannot substitute for the primary utility.

mechanism.bank: The new576 bank, finalD endpoint only; normal image-only path unchanged.
mechanism.primary_population: Probe12, primary FG-jitter slots0..7, equal mean of each case's mean valid primary-patch effect.
mechanism.donor_pools: Within case AND sampler stratum, restricted to attribute-valid known-nonempty slots; FG primary donors never include CT-uniform slots.
mechanism.permutation: Sort eligible slots, set shift=max(1,floor(n/2)) for n>=2, assign donors by right half-ring rotation. Both interventions use identical pools and donor indices.

interventions.name: raw_consumed_score_permutation
interventions.claim: Tests total consumed-score/input correspondence, not pure scale independently of presence.

interventions.name: own_presence_composition_permutation
interventions.formula: c'_i=(1-p0_i)*ordinal(r_donor(i)), with r=p[1:]/sum(p[1:]); if own and donor ordinal(r) are exactly equal at the consumed FP32 score precision, preserve the exact normal c_i.
interventions.zero_predicted_nonempty_mass: Unsupported with reason; no uniform fallback.
interventions.claim: Presence-controlled composition diagnostic; raw modulation amplitude/context explanations are not completely excluded.

support.GT_ordinal_variance: Report; semantic nondegeneracy gate is separate. No extra post-hoc GT-variance or delta-c threshold.
support.unsupported_case_effect: Null, never0; retain all12 descriptive case effects and explicit support/null flags.

gates_each_intervention.BCE_FP_FN_logit_responses: Fully report, not substituted for the fixed Dice/support criteria.
gates_each_intervention.threshold_meaning: Prespecified opportunity-cost effect-size rule, not an equivalence/significance test.

success_predicate.scientific_claim_scope: Reproduced dynamic ordinal-condition benefit and supported correspondence for this previously reused AVT development split; not a new blind patient-generalization or zero-shot result.

methodology_references.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
methodology_references.use: Finite validation-set optimization can overfit the model-selection criterion; independent seeds do not restore a pristine data holdout.
